integrity: The infinite statement is proved by a direct counting argument. Finite exhaustive checks are corroborative only. The later single-catalyst construction was explicitly compared and lies outside the model.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to independent single-use on/off selection from a fixed bank of eigenstate catalysts. It is not a lower bound for target-dependent controlled powers, repeated use, general catalytic embeddings, arbitrary constant-T-depth synthesis, or T-count.
title: Sharp register–activation tradeoff for selectable phase-kickback catalyst banks
